description: Roll out Istio sidecar injection to an existing production namespace containing 12 microservices. Enable automatic sidecar injection via namespace label, then route 1% of traffic through the mesh using a VirtualService and observe latency, error rate, and sidecar resource overhead for one hour. Ramp to 50% and observe again. If p99 latency increases by more than 200ms or error rate rises above the baseline, auto-rollback by removing the namespace label and patching all Deployments. Once 100% traffic is successfully routed through the mesh, decommission the legacy sidecar-free Deployments.
